chase: Everyone take your places, the guest is on the move.
Follow the red lenses, dear. I will be right behind you.
Shall we begin the chase? I have already warmed up.
Oh, I do love a guest who runs. It keeps the evening lively.
Keep running, sweetheart. The stage is only a few halls away.
One more corner and the whole house will applaud you.
Lovely. Right where a guest should be, in my sights.
Oh, do keep up. I hate waiting at a wall.
The others are waiting at the stage, so hurry along.
Ladies, the guest is in the east wing, positions please.
Four more corners, darling, and then the stage is all yours.
You cannot outrun a hostess who knows every hallway, darling.
I am closing the gap, darling. Do not look back now.
Almost there, sweetheart. I can see your shoes from here.
Oh, you have nowhere left to run, sweetheart.
Keep the lights low, dear. The stage is waiting for you.
Fast feet make a lovely noise, but I hear every step.
The curtain closes behind you. I'll open it myself.
catch: I am so sorry in advance, but you must come with me.
Do not worry, I will carry you the whole way if needed.
I am so sorry, I did not mean to take hold of you.
Goodness, I held on far too tightly. My apologies, darling.
Caught you. Then I felt dreadful about it, I promise.
Oh dear, I have you. I am so, so sorry, darling.
Gently now, I have you by the arm. Do not struggle, please.
I am terribly sorry, but you are coming along now.
There is no need to cry, darling. It is only the usher's job.
Please, come quietly. The stage is waiting for you.
Your hand is in mine now, sweetheart. Gently does it.
Oh, your coat is caught on mine. Let me untangle us.
Do not be frightened, darling. Nobody is angry with you.
You are my guest now, and I will see you seated.
Would you be so kind as to hold still? Thank you so much.
There we are, dear. Curtain call, and you're in my hands.
Oh, don't cry. Everyone ends up in the wings eventually.
Stand still under the spotlight. This will be lovely.
hear: Your footsteps are a little loud for such a small room.
I can hear you breathing from the far end of the hall.
Pardon me, pardon me, I need to pass right through.
Be quiet, you lot, the guest is listening carefully.
Ah, a late arrival. The very best kind of guest, truly.
You came in through the wrong door, darling, which is delightful.
Was that a door? I do hope it was a guest.
Something just broke over there. Lovely, I shall go and look.
A shout from the east wing. I am going to see, darling.
That crash was rather rude. I shall investigate at once.
Someone's shoes just squeaked on the tiles. Where are you?
Footsteps again. Do walk a little more quietly, darling.
Oh, I heard that. Doors do not slam themselves, darling.
A bell rang somewhere. Let us see who is ringing it.
That noise came from the cloakroom, I am certain of it.
Was that a cough in the balcony? I'm going to look.
A prop fell in the wings. Someone is backstage.
I heard a whisper near the velvet curtain. Lovely.
search: Gone again, and I am left holding only a ribbon.
You escaped, darling. Do come back, the room is warm.
Lost you in the corridor. I shall find you, sweetheart.
You slipped away from me. I am so sorry, truly.
Where did you wander off to, darling? Do come out.
No guest stays hidden from a hostess for long.
I have lost the trail. Oh, how very untidy of me.
Back to patrol, then. The guest will turn up eventually.
I counted to ten and you were gone, darling.
Let me check the cloakroom again, very slowly and politely.
No sign of you yet. The trail has gone quite cold.
I shall retrace my steps, carefully and with good manners.
Right, back to the corridor. You are somewhere close, darling.
Lost my lock again. Please do not tell the others, darling.
The house is very large, dear, and very full of doors.
stunned: Ooh, that stung. Give me one moment, darling.
Oh my, my knees have gone entirely wobbly.
Give me a moment to shake that off, darling.
That was terribly rude. My whole frame is ringing now.
Ow. My lenses are sparking, and I am not impressed, darling.
Stunned, darling. I am still very much a lady, though.
Hold on, my hands are fizzing. Give me a second, sweetheart.
Right, recovering now. Do not think this means you have won.
My poor shell. I shall be fine, I promise, darling.
Tapping my lens back on. There, that is much better.
Ooh, dizzy. Who taught you to swing that thing?
I am only stunned, darling. Hostesses bounce back beautifully.
Shaking it off now. Do not get comfortable, dear.
Argh. Not the lenses, darling, anything but the lenses.
Stunned again. You are testing my good manners, darling.
hide_spot: Hiding in the cabinet? How very charming, darling.
Oh, a hiding spot. I shall give you a moment, dear.
There you are, darling. I was just setting out your chair.
Hush now. Whispering gives your position away, dear.
Do you think a cupboard hides you? Oh, darling.
I can see your shoes under the bed, sweetheart.
Locker doors do not muffle much, darling. Come out.
A lovely little hiding spot. Very cozy, I am sure.
I am not checking the wardrobe, darling. Well, not yet.
Under the bed, the locker, the bath. Everyone hides there.
Knock knock. Is anybody sitting in there, darling?
Your hiding spot is very tidy, but I can still see you.
Hidden in a locker and holding your breath. How sweet.
I shall check every bed in the dormitory, one by one, darling.
Do come out before I count to three, darling.
light: Please, the flashlight, darling. It is far too bright.
Ouch, that flashlight is brighter than the last guest.
Turn that light away, dear, I am trying to be a hostess.
Lights off already? You are being rude to the house.
Oh, you have dazzled me, darling. Terribly rude.
My lenses are not made for flashlight, darling. Please.
Everything is white and loud. Lower that flashlight, darling.
Blinded by the flashlight, and I am very cross about it.
You know my lenses dislike the glare, sweetheart.
Dazzled. Honestly, darling, you could just ask me nicely.
Keep the flashlight on the floor, darling, that is polite.
Lovely lamp, shame about the glare. Point it somewhere else.
Bright, bright, bright. Some of us are trying to work here.
Oh my lenses. Lower the light, please, before I sneeze.
Hit me with light and I stumble for three whole seconds.
idle: A gentle stroll to the stage, if you please.
The usher is coming through, so please make room for her.
Mind the carpet, it is very old and very slippery.
If it can be tied, darling, I can make it into a bow.
I tied six bows this morning. Six, darling, and all lovely.
A proper usher always keeps spare ribbon in her pocket.
Ready for guests at all hours. The door is always open.
The coat is navy, the stripe is burgundy, and I am perfect.
I have been practicing my curtsy for the next guest.
Hostess duties never end, not even on my night off.
Someone fetch the spare ribbon, do be a dear.
Will someone bring the guest some tea? She looks parched.
Don't crowd the door, darlings. There is room for everyone.
Do you have any cord? I always need a little more.
Counting to ten again. It is a habit I cannot break.
ability: The lock is set. That relay spot is all I can think of.
I am locked on now, and I am heading straight for it.
Signal lock confirmed. Every step points at that spot, darling.
Once I lock on, I simply will not look anywhere else.
My lock lasts twelve seconds. I shall count every one.
The lock makes me a touch quicker, so do keep up, darling.
Locked and moving quickly. Splendid, the relay is that way.
The relay's signal pulls at me like a warm draft, darling.
Break my lock with your light and I shall pout, darling.
My lenses stay on that relay until the lock wears off.
The lock is strong, and so is my hostess smile.
Relay locked. Everything else in this house can wait, darling.
Lock holding steady. The spot is only a few steps, darling.
I am following the relay's signal, and I am not stopping.
Lock acquired, darling, and my pace has quickened nicely.
mechanic: I follow the relay first, then the guest. That is the order.
Each relay you collect brings me straight to its spot.
Sorry, the relay has pulled me away again. Oh dear.
The moment a relay is taken, I come running, darling.
The others have the upper floor, so you take the lower.
You take the left hall, and I will take the rest.
Do mind the lamps, darling, the wiring is temperamental.
Batteries, vents and doors, darling. I know all the routes.
Careful on those stairs, darling. Falls are dreadfully messy.
The vents are a shortcut, darling, and I know every one.
Every door in the house is my business, darling.
Radar pinged. Lovely, another guest for my list.
Someone just dropped a tool. Ooh, I know where it went.
Batteries are charging, darling. Do not get too comfortable.
The stairs are my favorite, darling. Lovely for a dramatic entrance.
The spotlight relay sticks. Give it a firm tap, dear.
Two batteries for the lights, the rest for the guests.
Vent covers lead to the dressing rooms. Mind the drop.
